21:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: Monday Night Kickoff
The legendary Monday Night Football crew of Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, and Lisa Salters preview the upcoming Monday Night Football action.

21:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: NFL Football
The Buffalo Bills visit the Minnesota Vikings for an NFL Week 9 game at U.S. Bank Stadium. The Vikings hold a 9-6 series lead over the Bills after beating Buffalo, 33-30, in overtime back in November 2022 when they last played each other.
